en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad Bin Isa, from Hareyz, from the one who informed him, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one in Ihraam cannot immerse himself into the water’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Hariz from those whom narrated to him who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
One in the state of Ihram must not submerge his head in the water.”’
